The big picture

What is Hive?

A shared network where different apps use the same account — the one you control.

◎

One account

Your Hive identity works across the whole ecosystem. No new sign-up for every app.

⌘

One ecosystem

Social, games, communities, and tools all connect to the same public network.

◇

You control it

Your keys unlock your account. You choose exactly what gets approved.
